description: Function-calling tool definitions for CPU-LLM. Each tool lists its JSON-Schema parameters and how it maps to the Python API and the HTTP service. CPU-LLM is an evidence engine, not a generative model: results are source-backed, derived, unverified (labelled UNVERIFIED_HYPOTHESIS), or refused. Branch on answer_status; never present unverified results as facts.

transport.python: from cpu_llm.pipeline import Appliance; app = Appliance(namespace=...)
transport.http: cpu-llm-serve --secrets credentials.json; POST with header 'Authorization: Bearer <secret>'

tools.name: cpu_llm_ask
tools.description: Ask the knowledge base. Returns a result with answer_status, reply.text, answer_evidence (document_id, quote, offsets, chunk_sha256), judgment, routing and a node receipt. Prompt forms select nodes: 'What is the <attribute> of <entity>?' with strict_evidence for exact quotes; 'Write a detailed report about X' for cited documents; 'Infer whether A is bigger than C' for rule proofs; 'Research X' for literature synthesis; 'Frontier: X' or 'What unexplored connections exist around X?' for ranked hypotheses; 'Deepen idea N' or 'Check this hypothesis: ...' to check one hypothesis. Send one specialist option per call.

strict_evidence.description: Exact source quotations, recognized exact calculations, or 'unsupported'. Answers named-attribute questions. Disables every hypothesis route.

session_id.description: Reuse for follow-ups: clarifications, 'Deepen idea 3' after Frontier, 'Explain proposal 1' after Invention.

finance.description: Check supplied LedgerCovenant or RefundProof fields.

inference.description: Explicit rule deduction {subject, relation, object} with relation in bigger_than, has, member_of, subclass_of, physical_part_of, physically_contains, located_in, requires; or a structured analysis {mode: temporal|inductive|abductive, source_ids: [...]}.

frontier.description: Run Frontier: ranked, cited, unverified hypotheses across the knowledge base. true, or {topic, limits, deepen_top}.

deepen.description: Run Deepen on one hypothesis: a Frontier hypothesis object (preferred), its text, or true to read the message.

invent.description: Concept invention from cited cross-chunk relationships (unverified).

as_of.description: Answer from the knowledge base as of this Unix time.

target_level.description: Simpler wording level such as A2 (needs Appliance(prismlexicon=True)).

tools.name: cpu_llm_ingest
tools.description: Add or replace a source. Re-ingesting the same name replaces its paragraphs. Accepted files: .txt .md .html .pdf .docx .csv .xlsx .xlsm .epub, or a folder.

source.description: A file or folder path readable by the service.

tools.name: cpu_llm_list_chunks
tools.description: Count and list active chunk ids visible to the caller, optionally for one source.
